review: Offline source transcription and scoring review
scoringBasis: Practice weighting: one point per scored response; the source does not specify item weights. All 70 questions retained. Questions 4, 9, 14, 21, 57, 60 and 66 are unscored because of multiple defensible answers, ambiguous regional/time-dependent claims, or imprecise wording. Figure questions use the original PDF. Broad subject alignment only; original restrictions differ.

review: Offline source transcription and scoring review
scoringBasis: Written questions 1–35 retained, with printed weights; hands-on 36–39 excluded (physical apparatus and measurements required). Q33 accepts both B and D: W/A and J/C both equal volts. Q35 is unscored because its published D answer conflicts with the dependence on number of turns. Q29 uses the source idealization, not a prediction about a real fuse. 2025 cover date overrides the 2026 archive season. Unrelated raw-score PDF omitted; blank answer sheet is not needed for the written questions.

review: Offline source transcription and scoring review
scoringBasis: All 33 numbered items retained. Printed weights: MCQ 1 each and written 3 each. Q24, Q30 and Q32 unscored for inconsistent key/wording or missing melting-temperature data. The unrelated football tiebreaker is omitted. Q33 follows expansion from installation at 20 °C to 50 °C. Full original heating-curve diagram retained.

review: Offline source transcription and scoring review
scoringBasis: Practice weighting: one point per reliable response; source item weights not specified. All nine items retained. Q2, Q6 and Q8 unscored because the published key is inconsistent with the paper or its arithmetic. Historical general food chemistry/baking, not the 2027 dairy rotation. No tournament name is claimed; the archive does not report one.

review: Offline source transcription and scoring review
scoringBasis: Published base puzzle weights from the scanned student paper. Puzzle 2 is absent from the supplied student PDF and is excluded despite appearing in the key. Includes timed puzzle base score only; no proctor-dependent timing or aggregate special bonuses. Current plaintext scoring: two free character errors, then 100-point deductions; spacing, punctuation and case ignored. Key-only answers are never shown before submission. Original cipher grids remain in the embedded source PDF.

review: Offline source transcription and scoring review
scoringBasis: All 86 numbered questions and original illustrations retained. Printed item weights total 195 before exclusions; Q9 (piezoelectric mismatch), Q34 (sulfur/H₂S confusion), and Q63 (volcanic-neck classification) are unscored. Matching and multipart answers use the published rubric; drawings accept equivalent labeled text. The source uses 2025 mineral lists; 2027 species/subtopic coverage may differ. Source cover is CSE 2025, overriding the archive’s 2026 season label.

review: Offline source transcription and scoring review
scoringBasis: Self-contained written section, using printed raw item points rather than the original section-weighted /100 total. Excludes the three physical powders, three suspect hair IDs, three suspect fiber IDs, suspect DNA comparison, shoe-comparison tasks and final suspect analyses: required samples/electropherograms/impressions are not supplied. Original microscopy, polymer and chromatogram figures remain in the full PDF. Chemistry item 7 is unscored for multiple basic substances; mass-spectrum numerical keys appear reversed and are unscored. Source third suspect-fiber question repeats “suspect 1”; it is excluded. No absent physical observations are fabricated.

scoringBasis: All 124 station questions retained with original illustrated test. Student-paper weights control where key annotations differ (for example station 1 question 2). Station 6 questions 3 and 5 have unreliable polymorphism/lead-detection claims. Station 15 question 1, station 16 question 1 and station 17 questions 1–2 remain unscored pending reliable diagram/rubric reconciliation. Source “Fluoraparite” spelling remains in station 11 rubric. Written rubrics require semantic/instructor review; original image identifications are not replaced by invented specimens. Cover date December 7, 2025 overrides 2026 season label.
